title: Gram Stain and the First Steps of Bacterial Identification
summary: Principle of the Gram stain, common morphologies and how the stain directs the identification workup.
objectives: Explain the biochemical basis of Gram reaction.
Describe the four-step Gram stain procedure.
Use Gram reaction plus morphology to start an identification algorithm.

highYield: Gram-positive cells retain crystal violet-iodine (thick peptidoglycan); gram-negative are decolorized and take safranin (thin peptidoglycan, outer membrane).
Over-decolorizing makes gram-positive look gram-negative; under-decolorizing does the reverse.
Gram reaction + shape narrows the workup: e.g., gram-positive cocci in clusters = Staphylococcus/Micrococcus.

deepStudy.introduction: The Gram stain (Hans Christian Gram, 1884) remains the most important rapid test in bacteriology: it confirms specimen quality, guides empiric therapy hours before culture results.

sections.heading: Procedure and quality
sections.body: Four steps: crystal violet (primary stain), Gram's iodine (mordant), acetone-alcohol (decolorizer), safranin (counterstain). A good smear is thin; flame-fixing is done for most specimens. Control strains: S. aureus (GPC) and E. coli (GNR).

sections.heading: Clinical use
sections.body: Polymorphonuclear cells on Gram stain of sterile-site fluids indicate infection; squamous epithelial cells in sputum (>10/LPF) indicate oropharyngeal contamination and the specimen should be recollected.

deepStudy.clinicalSignificance: Direct Gram stain results can change empiric antibiotic therapy within minutes of specimen collection.
deepStudy.labInterpretation: Report Gram stain findings quantitatively and note specimen quality. Organism morphology can be altered by prior antibiotic therapy (gram-variable forms).
examTraps: Mycoplasma lacks a cell wall and does not Gram stain; Chlamydia is gram-negative but intracellular and rarely seen.
Old cultures of gram-positive organisms appear gram-variable — always test young colonies.

memoryHooks.text: Decolorize = the 'make or break' step of the Gram stain.
memoryHooks.funny: Meow: 'Ang decolorizer ay parang exam results — masyadong matagal = breakdown. Konti lang, tapos na.'
